affinity.notes: Its identity is physical and equipment-driven, with no dominant elemental construction.

anatomy.notes: Compact humanoid proportions and equipment handling are readable.

archetype.notes: Frontline shield tank does not communicate the intended mobile-cover breacher duty.

counterplay.notes: The oversized frontal shield clearly implies protected front and punishable exposed flank or sword side.

finish.notes: Good separation and convincing worn equipment.

framing.notes: Shield, sword, face, and feet remain visible.

identity.notes: Small goblin shield soldier identifies the Goblin Raider form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T2, not exact intended tier T3.
